driver: E&G Payroll Cost Inflation, Support Mix & Incremental Budgeting
audited_anchor: Total E&G FTE grew +7.0% (3,506 -> 3,752, FY15-26, matching +6.6% Student FTE; Central General Admin Fmt 1600 = 239.1 FTE / 6.4% of E&G FTE, budgeted at 187.4 in FY27), while Academic + Student Support rose +39.9% (+224 FTE) and each 3% comp/fringe pool adds ~$33.7M/yr.
methodology_note: Order-of-magnitude illustration reflecting the ~70%+ personnel share of E&G expenditures, cumulative benefit/wage inflation, and fixed base carry-forwards.

audited_anchor: CSU System Debt doubled from $671.9M (FY13) to $1,449.3M peak (FY23) / $1,330.7M (FY25) + $79.1M FY25 STRATA Laser bond. E&G Central Debt Service more than tripled from $10.2M (FY15) to $31.9M (FY26).
methodology_note: Captures hard bond covenants, debt service, and new building O&M/utilities that remain fixed during enrollment dips.

driver: Athletics Net Operating Subsidy (Excl. Bonded Debt)
audited_anchor: Gross spending $75.24M (FY25), Direct+Indirect Univ Support $26.00M + $6.14M student fees, minus $10.93M athletic aid flow-back = ~$15.6M net institutional operating support (B2 E&G = $17.15M in FY26).
methodology_note: Excludes $206.96M bonded athletic debt (counted in Bucket 2 to prevent double-counting) and student fees paid outside E&G.

driver: State Funding Limits, Tuition Discounting & F&A Scope
audited_anchor: FY27 State FFS+COF flat at $211.1M (23.4% of State Approp); System discount rate rose 17.9% (FY17) -> 21.3% (FY25, $174.1M); Nov. 2026 Amend. 87 (+$1.97B FY28) & Prop NN relieve K-12/Medicaid General Fund crowding but remain earmarked outside E&G instruction.
methodology_note: Reflects state TABOR/Medicaid crowding prior to Nov. 2026 reforms + institutional merit aid competition for non-resident students.
